name: repo-wiki
description: Node.js CLI and library for compiling any Git repository and its validated documentation into a GitHub Wiki knowledge base.

scripts.smoke:consumer: set -eu; tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT; npm pack --pack-destination "$tmp_dir" >/dev/null; tarball=$(ls "$tmp_dir"/repo-wiki-*.tgz 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$tarball" ]; then echo 'No tarball produced' >&2; exit 1; fi; consumer_dir="$tmp_dir/consumer"; mkdir -p "$consumer_dir"; cd "$consumer_dir"; npm init -y >/dev/null; npm install --no-audit --no-fund "$tarball" >/dev/null; npx --no-install repo-wiki --help >/dev/null
scripts.coverage: npm run build && npm run coverage:compiled
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:compiled
scripts.scan:bootstrap: npm run build --silent && node ./dist/bin/repo-wiki.js scan --mode bootstrap --repo . --out .llmwiki/run
scripts.kb:bootstrap: npm run build --silent && node ./dist/bin/repo-wiki.js run --mode bootstrap --repo . --scan .llmwiki/run --plan .llmwiki/bootstrap-plan.json --wiki .llmwiki/wiki
scripts.kb:incremental: npm run build --silent && node ./dist/bin/repo-wiki.js run --mode incremental --repo . --scan .llmwiki/run --plan .llmwiki/incremental-plan.json --wiki .llmwiki/wiki
